description: The FX-888DX is a temperature-controlled bench soldering station. It has a pen-style iron, an iron holder and tip-cleaning tools. In the makerspace it is used for through-hole and surface-mount electronics, wiring, connectors and repairs. You set the temperature by turning one push-button dial, and it can store up to five preset temperatures. The tips are interchangeable, and other compatible handpieces can be connected.

specs.label: Tips
specs.value: T18 series (T18-D16 1.6 mm chisel supplied with the US model)

materials: Printed circuit boards and electronic components
ppeRequired: Fume extraction or a well-ventilated workstation
useRestrictions: Use only for soldering, with fume extraction or good ventilation, and always put the hot iron back in its holder when you are not using it.
